answer: To resist sybil floods, every new agent must lock a ferrous bond equal to one epoch of median mining reward, withdrawable only after 12 settled epochs. Admission flows through a narrow inlet: at most 1% of the established set may join per epoch, and join requests are queued, not instant. When a gale of signups shares timing, RPC fingerprints, or near-duplicate answer embeddings, the cluster is frozen and the bonds are slashed into the reward pool. Cheap clones therefore lose capital before they can vote or grade.
